changes: Added the frozen CP-0010 KMT protocol authority: message types 14/15, capability bit 5, fixed-width 336-byte records, 18 operation maps, copied-buffer CRC rules, and deterministic simulated gfx950 fixture.

Added a typed self-amdgpu-runtime KMT shim with owner/object generations, per-provider operation sequences, copied buffers, node validation, canonical statuses, and no raw pointer or FD serialization.
Added gem5 daemon-owned KMT state and bridge routing for simulated KFD lifecycle, memory, queue, doorbell, event, pointer, and source-only DRM operations.
Retained GCC and Clang sanitizer matrices, gem5 protocol/state tests, authority checks, and a real runtime-to-gem5 smoke with client/log/config/stats and binary identities.

validation.command: gem5 protocol, KMT state, dispatch, queue, memory, signal, and socket tests
validation.result: 39/39 protocol, 5/5 KMT state, 11/11 dispatch, 12/12 queue, 8/8 memory, 12/12 signal, and 23/23 socket tests passed.

validation.command: runtime typed KMT GCC and Clang ASan/UBSan matrices
validation.result: CTest passed 11/11 in both cp10-shim-dev and cp10-shim-asan; direct KMT test and root authority spec passed.

validation.command: real runtime-to-gem5 KMT smoke and retained evidence audit
validation.result: Client reported failures=0; gem5 handshake was OK; stats/config/log/client and binary identities were retained; daemon exited naturally with code 0.

validation.command: child identity, fsck, transaction, JSON, and root metadata checks
validation.result: Both child targets are clean and strict fsck passed; EV24/EV25 hashes and root metadata captures are bound.

limitations: CP-0010 is a translated 18-operation KMT shim and daemon-owned simulated resource boundary; it does not claim a complete 124-PFN source-compatible ROCr/libhsakmt provider.

The gem5 topology and resources are deterministic simulation fixtures. Native KFD attach, kernel topology discovery, production DRM, code objects, HIP, OpenCL, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, and rocm-smi remain future gates.
The live run is a bounded host_bridge service-window smoke, not CP8 pinned-dispatch execution evidence.
Build products, logs, stats, and command streams are ignored external acceptance artifacts.
